name: Verliebt in Berlin
description: The original season follows the life of the unsophisticated but good-natured Lisa Plenske, and her incongruous job at the ultra-chic Berlin fashion house Kerima Moda; while the second season revolved around Lisa's ham-fisted but sly half-brother Bruno and junior designer Hannah Refrath.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Both David and Rokko have proposed to Lisa. Meanwhile, the wedding preparations are already underway, and now she has to decide on the right man.
